cvStructure.issue: Your contact details don't include a LinkedIn, GitHub, or portfolio link, which is expected for an AI/Machine Learning Engineer application.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a LinkedIn profile and a GitHub link (showing your Date-Palm classifier and Demand Forecast Service code) near your contact details, writing out the full web address as visible text.

cvStructure.issue: Your Skills section sits after Certifications and Projects, so it is one of the last things an ATS or recruiter reads even though it's key for screening.
cvStructure.suggestion: Reorder your sections as Summary, Education, Skills, Projects, Experience, Certifications, Activities, Languages so your technical skills are visible right after Education.

keywordUsage.issue: Your Skills section lists libraries like scikit-learn and PyTorch but doesn't name the fields they support, such as Machine Learning and Deep Learning, which recruiters search for directly.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add 'Machine Learning' and 'Deep Learning' as keywords in your Skills section, since your gradient-boosted model and ResNet-50 work already demonstrate both.

keywordUsage.issue: Your Date-Palm Leaf Disease Classifier project shows computer vision work, but 'Computer Vision' isn't listed anywhere in your Skills section.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add 'Computer Vision' to your Skills section to match this project and the AI/ML Engineer role you're targeting.

keywordUsage.issue: The Demand Forecast Service project describes wrapping a model in FastAPI and Docker but doesn't use the standard term for this work.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Describe this project using the term 'model deployment' (for example, 'deployed the model as a REST API with FastAPI and Docker') so ATS systems can match it to deployment-related job keywords.

readability.issue: Your Summary is written as a first-person story ('I enjoy turning messy data into working models...') instead of short, direct statements.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite the Summary without 'I', for example: 'Computer Science graduate focused on machine learning and computer vision, with hands-on experience building and deploying models.'

readability.issue: The dashboard-building point in your Data Analyst Intern role has no measurable result.
readability.suggestion: Add a number to this point, such as how many reports you produced or [percentage] improvement in how fast the operations manager could act on the data.

readability.issue: The Demand Forecast Service project describes what you built but doesn't state a result.
readability.suggestion: Add a result such as [response time] of the API or [number] of times the team used it from the dashboard.

contentFormatting.issue: Dates are written in different styles across your CV: 'Jun 2025 - Aug 2025' in Experience, plain years like '2026' in Projects and Certifications, and years in parentheses like '(2024 - 2025)' in Activities.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Pick one consistent date style, such as 'Mon YYYY - Mon YYYY' or just 'YYYY', and use it the same way in every section.
